mode.description: Recording mode: hold button to record, or click to toggle on/off.

transcriptionEngine.description: Where transcription runs. 'client' uses parakeet.js WebGPU/WASM in the browser. 'server' sends audio to the dashboard server for processing. Server mode is recommended for mobile.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for speech recognition (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'de').

serverEngine.description: Server-side STT engine. 'parakeet-onnx' uses the same NVIDIA Parakeet ONNX models as the client via onnxruntime-node (local, no API key). 'openai-whisper' uses the OpenAI API (requires API key). Only used when transcriptionEngine is 'server'.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for openai-whisper server engine. Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY env var.

parakeetModelRepo.description: HuggingFace repo for Parakeet ONNX model files. Only used when serverEngine is 'parakeet-onnx'.

vadThreshold.description: Voice Activity Detection sensitivity threshold. Lower = more sensitive.

parakeetModelUrl.description: URL to parakeet.js ONNX model files. Leave empty to use default CDN (Hugging Face).
